messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, raises one hand to her head, shifts her weight, and turns into profile while adjusting her hair.","camera":"Static, low-angle full-body shot from behind the character.","clothing":"A short, long-sleeved blue-and-white patterned dress with an open back, and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Platinum blonde / white.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky hair that is later gathered into a small ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a swing ride on the left, a lit carousel-style structure on the right, and a sunset sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a neon futuristic city to a dusk amusement park matching the reference, including a swing ride, popcorn stand, and lit carousel structure. The character remains in a similar pose sequence, wearing the same blue-and-white dress and red shoes, and the camera remains a static low-angle full-body shot from behind. The character's lighting now appears warmer and consistent with the sunset environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the futuristic city scene with the amusement park environment from the reference, while keeping the character's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement unchanged, and adapt the character's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the hair color change is an unintended alteration or a result of adapting the character's lighting to the warmer target environment.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair appears more platinum blonde/white in the output than the pinkish tone visible in the source.
